# ChatGPT Image Generation Prompts — Claude Usage Plugin

## HOW TO USE

1. Open ChatGPT (GPT-4o with image generation)
2. Upload the reference screenshots you have of the adx.cool AI Token Tracker listing
3. Paste one prompt at a time
4. Say: "Use the uploaded images as the exact visual reference for style, layout, and tone"

After you get the base image, follow up with:
"Add the Ratpack logo (white rat icon + 'Ratpack' text) in the top left corner"
Then upload your Ratpack logo image.

Elgato Marketplace screenshot size: **1920×1080** (16:9)

---

## PROMPT 1 — Hero / Main Screenshot

Upload the adx.cool hero screenshot first, then paste:

```
Using the uploaded image as the exact style reference, create a 1920x1080 product marketing screenshot for a Stream Deck plugin called "Claude Usage" by Ratpack.

Layout: Left half has large bold white text. Right half shows an Elgato Stream Deck MK2 device at a slight angle, with illuminated keys.

Left side text:
- Small orange badge at top: "LIVE USAGE MONITOR"
- Giant bold white heading: "Claude Usage"
- Subheading in muted gray: "Know if you can keep going — at a glance."
- Three bullet points with orange arrow "→":
  → 8 display styles · 3 themes · per-key customization
  → Live 5-hour + weekly limits, updates every 30 sec
  → Short-press to change style · Long-press to switch type
- Two small pill badges at bottom: "macOS · Windows" and "Stream Deck 6.5+"

Right side — Stream Deck MK2 keys show:
- Key 1: Circular gauge ring showing "42%" in bright green (#30E27B), label "5H", time "2h 14m" in white below
- Key 2: Circular gauge ring showing "78%" in amber/orange (#FFD60A), label "7D", time "1h 40m" in white below  
- Key 3: Circular gauge ring showing "95%" in bright red (#FF3B30), label "5H", time "12m" in white below
- Key 4: Overview key showing two stacked bars labeled "5H 42%" and "WEEK 78%"
- Key 5: Water fill key, blue-orange fill rising 78% from bottom, "78%" centered
- Key 6: Big text key showing "2h 14m" in white, "5-HOUR RESETS IN" label above

Background: Very dark, almost black (#0d1117), subtle dark navy radial glow behind the Stream Deck device. No lens flare. Clean and premium like a Linear or Raycast product page.
```

## TIPS FOR BEST RESULTS

- Always upload one of the adx.cool reference screenshots before pasting the prompt
- If the keys look wrong, follow up: "Make the Stream Deck keys larger and more centered. The gauge text should be bigger and bolder."
- For the Ratpack logo: after you have the base image, ask "Add a small white Ratpack rat logo and 'Ratpack' text in the top-left corner" and upload your logo
- If colors are off: "The green should be #30E27B (electric mint green), the red should be #FF3B30 (iOS red), orange accent #FF8A3D"
- Resolution: ask for 1920x1080 explicitly, Elgato Marketplace requires 16:9
